RELATIONSHIP TYPES HIDDEN IN THE BUSINESS CASE
City–Member/Warehouse; Warehouse–Employee; Member referrals; Category hierarchy; Item–Auction.
Member–Auction through Bid; Member–Auction through AuctionFollower.
Employee works in Warehouse; each Warehouse is managed by an Employee.
ItemPhoto is identified by (ItemId, Position) and depends on its Item.
[FK] = Foreign Key; arrow points to the referenced PK
Country attributes follow the COUNTRY/CITY notation example shown on page 4 of the assignment. Types and SQL constraints are implemented in Task 2.
